scripts.setup: uv sync && ln -s "$CONDUCTOR_ROOT_PATH/.env" .env && bash -lc 'if [ -L models ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -d models ] && [ -z "$(ls -A models)" ]; then rmdir models; fi; if [ ! -e models ]; then shared_dir=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.." && pwd); ln -s "$shared_dir/models" models; fi'
